title: Clean Procedural Legacy Code
description: Remove all legacy/deprecated code from procedural module - legacy brep flow kinds, deprecated APIs (BrepViewport, ProceduralEditor, extractGeometryHandles, ProceduralGeometryHandle), and clean refactor.
summary: Removed all legacy procedural surface area: six duplicate brep flow kinds (brep.box/sphere/cylinder/extrude/translate/union) and their eval handlers; deprecated APIs (BrepViewport, ProceduralEditor, extractGeometryHandles, ProceduralGeometryHandle); renamed BrepViewport region to ProceduralPreview. Cleaned @semio-tech/geometry-brep-js by dropping LegacySolid wrappers (createBoxFromCorners*, fuseSolids*, etc.) from kernel and BrepKernel contract; tests now use boxSync/spherePrimSync/fuseAllSync/measureVolumeSync/tessellateGeometry. Updated procedural/play extension fixture test and DAG layout tests to brep.prim3d.box.
